AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  APRIL 20, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE
VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  5:15 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to proclaim April 30, 2021 as Arbor Day in the City of Norwalk.

  II.  City Council to proclaim April as Public Schools Month in the City of Norwalk.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES ON THE AGENDA - Staff recommends City Council
  waive reading in full of all ordinances on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the
  public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading waived.
 2.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of April 6
  and 13, 2021. 825-04

  Minutes

3.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period March 7, 2021 – March
  20, 2021, in the total amount of $871,964.79. 630

  Report

4.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  April 1, 2021 – April 14, 2021, in the total amount of $750,812.40. 640

  Warrant Register

5.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claims filed by Steve
  Haagsma and Frank Porraz. 830-08/16

  Report

6.  ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 21-1724 - CORRECTING ORDINANCE NO. 20-1717 ADOPTING ZONE
  CHANGE NO. 361 – ASSESSOR’S PARCEL NUMBER 8046-005-900, ALSO KNOWN AS 12801
  FIRESTONE BOULEVARD - Staff recommends City Council adopt Ordinance No. 21-1724, AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK SETTING FORTH ITS
  FINDINGS OF FACT AND DECISION APPROVING ZONE CHANGE NO. 361. 320-09-361

  Report

7.  AWARD OF CONTRACT – CITYWIDE ELEVATOR MAINTENANCE SERVICES - Staff recommends
  City Council approve an agreement with Pacific Coast Elevator/dba Amtech Elevator Services to
  provide maintenance and repair services of city-owned elevators for the term of July 1, 2021 through
  June 30, 2024, with the option to extend for five (5) additional one (1) year periods pursuant to the
  terms and conditions of contract number 2019001563; and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  agreement and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms
  approved by the City Attorney. 955

  Report

8.  PROJECT NO. 7857 - AWARD OF CONTRACT - LANDSCAPE ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN FOR THE
  MEDIAN TURF REPLACEMENT AND DROUGHT TOLERANT PLANT ENVIRONMENTAL
  ENHANCEMENT AND MITIGATION PROGRAM (EEMP) GRANT FOR ROSECRANS AVENUE,
  FIRESTONE BOULEVARD, AND IMPERIAL HIGHWAY - Staff recommends City Council authorize the
  City Manager to execute an agreement and any amendments with David Volz Design of Costa Mesa in
  the amount of $26,996 to provide landscape architectural design services for the EEMP grant project,
  providing there is funding in the budget, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7857

  Report

9.  PROJECT NOS. 7924, 7925, AND 7926 - RESOLUTION NOS. 21-19 and 21-20 – BUDGET
  AMENDMENTS AND AWARD CONTRACT – CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION
  SERVICES FOR SECOND STAGE OF CONSTRUCTION FOR LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION
  PROGRAM – ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-13 - Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-19, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “M” BOND PROCEEDS FOR
  CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION SERVICES FOR 2nd STAGE OF
  CONSTRUCTION FOR LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION PROGRAM, PHASE 1, PROJECT
  NO. 7924 - ZONE 24, in the amount of $37,590;

  b.  adopt Resolution No. 21-20, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “R” BOND PROCEEDS FOR
   CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION SERVICES FOR 2nd STAGE OF
  CONSTRUCTION FOR LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION PROGRAM, PHASE 1, PROJECT
  NO. 7925 - ZONE 27 AND PROJECT NO. 7926 - ZONE 32, in the amount of $75,180; and

  c.  award a contract to LAE Associates Inc. in the amount of $112,770 for construction management
  and inspection services; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract, and any
  amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney. 610/1005-04-7924/7925/7926

  Report

10. PROJECT NOS. 7924, 7925, and 7926 - RESOLUTION NOS. 21-21 and 21-22 – BUDGET
  AMENDMENT AND AWARD OF CONTRACT – CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION
  SERVICES FOR THIRD STAGE OF CONSTRUCTION FOR LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION
  PROGRAM – ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-14 - Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-21, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “M” BOND PROCEEDS FOR
  CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION SERVICES FOR 3rd STAGE OF
  CONSTRUCTION FOR LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION PROGRAM, PHASE 1, PROJECT
  NO. 7924 - ZONE 24, in the amount of $27,540;

  b.  adopt Resolution No. 21-22, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “R” BOND PROCEEDS FOR
  CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION SERVICES FOR 3rd STAGE OF
  CONSTRUCTION FOR LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION PROGRAM, PHASE 1, PROJECT
  NO. 7925 - ZONE 27 AND PROJECT NO. 7926 - ZONE 32, in the amount of $55,080; and

  c.  award a contract to Onward Engineering in the amount of $82,616 for construction management
  and inspection services; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract, and any
  amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney. 610/1005-04-7924/7925/7926

  Report

11. ACCEPT WORK - CONSTRUCTION OF I-5 FREEWAY IMPROVEMENTS - CARMENITA SEGMENT,
  SEGMENT 3, AND SEGMENT 4; APPROVE FREEWAY MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT; AND
  ACCEPT LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE RESPONSIBILITIES FOR PROJECT - Staff recommends
  City Council:

  a.  accept construction work by the State of California Department of Transportation for the Interstate-
  5 Freeway improvements - Carmenita Segment, Segment 3, and Segment 4;

  b.  approve Caltrans Freeway Maintenance Agreement;

  c.  accept landscape maintenance responsibilities for project; and

  d.  authorize the City Manager to execute required acceptance letters and agreements for the project,
  on behalf of the City, and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget. 1015-02

  Report

  Council approve the 2021 Title VI Program Update for submittal to Federal Transit Administration. 1120

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  13. ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

REPORTS

  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT AND HOME INVESTMENT PARTNERSHIPS

  Report
